question: Does fixed colony composition plus the observed island-total trajectory and count stochasticity reproduce the observed size-selective durable colony loss?
observed_statistic: Use the exact durable-loss risk-set size contrast from PALMER_COLONY_EXTINCTION_HAZARD_V1, with equal weight per informative island-year risk set.
neutral_state: Within each island, cumulative 1991-2017 colony-code shares are fixed through time; each year's latent colony means equal those shares times the observed island total.
positive_total_conditioning: If an observed island-year total is positive, redraw a simulated island-year only when its simulated aggregate is zero.
p_value: lower-tail Monte Carlo probability with +1 correction among valid simulated statistics
decision: Reject this neutral explanation only when p <= 0.05 in all three models for COR+HUM+LIT; the stronger result additionally requires the same for COR+HUM.
boundaries: This is a post-primary-result mechanism control, not an outcome-blind preregistration.
Passing this control does not identify predation, social facilitation, snow or dispersal.
Failing this control blocks an Allee-like biological interpretation of the primary size effect.
The CV models are stylized rather than empirically calibrated observer-error estimates.
